text: Added a --watch flag to `lark build` that rebuilds on file change. Previously you had to re-run the command manually.
Fixed a crash when the config file contains a byte-order mark. Files saved from Windows editors now load correctly.
Upgraded internal dependencies and cleaned up the build pipeline.
Search results now load in under 200ms for projects with up to 10,000 files, down from 1.4s.
The `lark export` command now supports CSV output via --format csv.
Refactored the scheduler module for maintainability.
Error messages for invalid YAML now include the line and column of the problem.
